scientific_integrity.computational_method: Exact integer and rational enumeration using a standalone Python standard-library verifier.
scientific_integrity.not_claimed: No claim about arbitrary observables, all dyadic resolutions, or independence of real-valued coordinates.
scientific_integrity.proven_results: Exact de Bruijn coboundary classification and Green–Kubo form; stationary central limit theorem from finite dependence.

scientific_limitations: The target density is strictly positive and continuous on a compact rectangle and its Rosenblatt transform is invertible almost everywhere.
The threshold classification covers binary resolutions of at most four digits; it is not an all-resolution theorem.
The probability and limit statements assume stationary initialization and disregard null-set binary-expansion ambiguities.
The symbolic checker verifies finite exact arithmetic; the infinite-time conclusions follow from the mathematical proof.
Publication priority remains subject to potentially unindexed or unavailable related literature.
title: Rank-one four-bit diffusion and a dyadic noise threshold for Rosenblatt baker maps
